name: Manual HTTP Health Check
description: Manually triggered workflow that calls an external health endpoint and returns the response.
expected_documentation:
# Manual HTTP Health Check

## Overview
Lets an operator probe an external service on demand to confirm it is reachable.

## Prerequisites
None. The workflow calls the public endpoint https://api.example.com/health and needs no connections, secrets, or environment variables.

## Trigger
Manual Trigger — started by a user; accepts optional input data.

## Walkthrough
1. Start (Manual Trigger) begins the run.
2. Health Check (HTTP Request) issues a GET to https://api.example.com/health with a 5000 ms timeout and emits the status code, headers, body, and duration.

## Data Flow
The run carries no input; Health Check produces the HTTP response for downstream use.

## Decisions
None.

## Error Handling
None configured: a timeout after 5000 ms or a non-2xx response fails the run.
